Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Request for recent vulnerability scan cadence and triage logs

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG assessment for ThirdWave we need a compact deliverable covering your vulnerability management evidence for the last 90 days. Specifically we are asking for: 

- A scan cadence matrix (tool, scope, frequency, owners) covering all prod and infra scopes.
- A recent triage log (last 30 days) showing CVE IDs, severity, status, assigned owner, and remediation ETA.
- Your SLA for CVE remediation by severity (P1/P2/P3) and escalation path for exceptions.

Can you provide a single bundle (CSV + plaintext log + short attestation PDF) or share a drive link by EOD Friday? If you have an internal runbook that describes when exceptions are granted, that would be helpful as well.

Also useful: the name and email for the engineer we can follow up with on any clarifying questions.

Best,
Jenna Holt
Security Assessor, ThirdWave

--
ThirdWave - 1 Embarcadero Center

Laura/Marissa —

Attached are the artifacts I put together this morning: a condensed scan-matrix CSV (columns: scope, tool, cadence, owner, last-run), a redacted triage log that lists CVE, severity, status, owner, and ETA (no ticket bodies), and a one-page remediation commitments PDF with the SLA table. Highlights:

- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans for infra control-plane; daily passive container scanning for images in our CI registry; monthly external perimeter scans.
- SLA (by severity): P1 (critical/exploitable in prod) = 7 days to mitigation plan and 30 days to remediation OR documented exception; P2 = 30 days; P3 = 90 days. Exceptions are approved by Security and SRE lead and recorded in the exception tracker.
- Recent 30d triage: 12 total issues; 2 P1s (both mitigated with config change and backported patch), 4 P2s in remediation, remainder P3 backlog.

Attachments (sent internally): scan-matrix-2026-05.csv, cve-triage-log-2026-05.txt, remediation-commitments-2026-05.pdf
